d: We are seeking a commercially minded Senior Legal Counsel to join our legal team in Abu Dhabi, with primary responsibility for structuring, drafting, and negotiating commercial contracts across the business.

This role is ideal for a qualified lawyer with a strong technology/SaaS contracting background who is looking to make the move in-house (or continue their in-house career) to a fast-paced, high-growth AI company.
You will be working directly with the General Counsel and commercial leadership to enhance the contracting function as we scale.
q: Qualified lawyer (solicitor/attorney) in the US, UK, Australia, or Canada.
Essential: substantial experience negotiating and drafting commercial contracts, ideally within a technology or SaaS environment.
A mix of private practice and in-house experience is strongly preferred.
Experience advising on data protection/privacy matters in a commercial contracting context is a plus.
Genuine interest in AI and its legal frontier. Hands-on use of AI tools in your own workflow is a plus.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance legal risk against business objectives.
Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to work independently and manage a high volume of contracts.
Comfortable operating in a lean legal function and working cross-functionally with non-legal stakeholders.
Clear, confident communicator, able to explain legal concepts to a commercial audience.
Adaptable and pragmatic, with a solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving.
r: li

Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of commercial agreements, including SaaS/software licensing agreements, master services agreements, data processing agreements, NDAs, partnership and reseller agreements, procurement contracts, and vendor agreements.
li
Act as a trusted legal business partner to Sales, Product, Engineering, Procurement, and other commercial teams, providing pragmatic, risk-calibrated advice that supports deal velocity.
li
Manage the full contract lifecycle, from initial drafting through negotiation, execution, and post-signature amendments.
li
Identify and escalate key legal and commercial risks (liability, IP, AI/ML training data and model IP, data protection, termination, indemnities) with practical mitigation strategies.
li
Own the development and maintenance of contract templates, playbooks, and precedent libraries to improve efficiency and consistency.
li
Advise on data privacy and cross-border data transfer issues relevant to technology/SaaS agreements.
li
Liaise with external counsel across relevant jurisdictions as needed.
li
Support ad hoc corporate, regulatory, and compliance matters as required. Expect exposure to fundraising, commercial strategy, and go-to-market decisions.
li
Lead process improvement initiatives, including contract automation and using AI tools to redesign how legal work is completed.
x: Opportunity to build and shape the legal function from scratch in a rapidly scaling AI company
Exposure to a broad range of commercial and strategic matters
